code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    objs=[]; seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] in (2,8) and (r,c) not in seen:
                color=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]; seen.add((r,c))
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x,g[y][x]))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]!=bg:
                            seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
                objs.append((color,cells))
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for direction in (2,8):
        group=[o for o in objs if o[0]==direction]
        group.sort(key=lambda o:min(x for y,x,v in o[1]),reverse=(direction==2))
        for color,cells in group:
            r0=min(y for y,x,v in cells); r1=max(y for y,x,v in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x,v in cells); c1=max(x for y,x,v in cells)
            newc=w-1-c1 if direction==2 else c0
            def free(nc):
                return all(out[y][x-c0+nc]==bg for y,x,v in cells)
            while not free(newc): newc += -1 if direction==2 else 1
            for y,x,v in cells: out[y][x-c0+newc]=v
    return out
'''
